title: Kusanagi Nene — Determined Director〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: After school
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Soda
rows.Line: Alright, stunt team, let's go down to the schoolyard to practice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They sound pretty excited...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And I need to keep editing the screenplay when I get home.)

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Kusanagi, are you free after this?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh... Y-Yeah, I'm free...
Is there something you wanted to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: So, I was hoping to decide what the costumes are gonna look like soon.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: We on the costume team brought in a bunch of our clothes that might kinda fit the setting, so we were going to talk things over while going through them.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: But I thought it might be better to ask you first since you know the most about our film's characters.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
Then, I'll be happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Really?! Thanks so much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, it sounds like you're already putting a ton of thought into the costumes... I'm not even done with the script yet...

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: There's nothing wrong with having stuff ready early, right? Having costumes to wear should give the cast a nice boost of motivation, and we can always make fixes later.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Tachibana really knows what she's doing...
I wasn't expecting her to be so helpful.)

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Anyway, can you come with me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... R-Right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kusanagi! I didn't know you'd be coming!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Me neither.
But they had some questions about the costumes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, we heard that as well!
They wanted to hear our opinions since we know a thing or two about fashion.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fashion's one thing, but we're talking about costumes for our film here...

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Hey, we're in the same boat.
It's been mostly trial and error so far, so any help we can get would be really appreciated!

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
So, thank you all for coming.
Let's get started, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Let's see... Starting with...
How about the girl's costume?
Any suggestions are welcome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Wow, look at this frilly dress! It's super cute!

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Oh, I brought that one because it sorta had this heroine feel to it. But frills don't really fit into our setting, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hmm, yeah...
It is cute, but I'm not sure it's going to fit into this film's world.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She and everyone else live in an arid wasteland, and her family isn't well-off, so something that makes her look more impoverished might be better.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay...
Got it, we'll try something simpler then! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
By the way...
Kusanagi, wanna try this dress on?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? Wh-Why...?!

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Because I think you'd look really good in it♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, geez...
I thought we were here to talk about costumes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, but I also kinda want to see Kusanagi in this dress... I agree that you'd probably look amazing in it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
See what I mean?
Alright, An, get her!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Roger!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Shiraishi...?
N-No, don't come any closer...!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Sorry we made you try on so many things, Kusanagi. But we have a much better idea of what to do now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Really? Then, I guess that's good...?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yup! Now, I need to go discuss things further with everyone on my team! Thanks a ton!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry about that, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean... You had it pretty rough...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha...
Oh, but that one-piece dress with an Asian feel looked so good on you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
An Asian feel...?
You mean the white one with the flowers embroidered in?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that one! Tachibana and I were talking about how good you look in those kinds of dresses.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're usually all cool and collected, so outfits with a loose feel to them probably suit you really well!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! We couldn't stop talking about what kinds of outfits we wanted to dress you up in!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-I'm not sure how to feel about that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, at least they know what to do about the costumes now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, true... And I think I have a better idea of what the characters are gonna look like now that we know more about their costumes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: As exhausting as that discussion was, I think it was necessary in order to make our film as good as it can be...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You think so? In that case, Tachibana said that she wants to talk more again about some different costumes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Good luck, Director...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, I know that I have to work hard in order to make our film a good one...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I know that, but...!)
